<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919961_theRebbe_975" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919961_theRebbe_975__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The soul's primary purpose is to make the world a dwelling place for G-d, and fulfilling this mission elevates the soul incomparably more than any lofty revelations.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, since the intention of the soul's descent below is to make the world a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="2">it is therefore understood</t>
    <t s="3">that this matter</t>
    <t s="4">(making the dwelling place for Him, blessed be He)</t>
    <t s="5">is a primary matter in its standing and condition.</t>
    <t s="6">For when it does not fulfill its mission and function, G-d forbid,</t>
    <t s="7">even if it has the most sublime revelations,</t>
    <t s="8">the essential thing is lacking.</t>
    <t s="9">And on the other hand,</t>
    <t s="10">by fulfilling the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms,</t>
    <t s="11">a great and wondrous elevation beyond measure is effected within it.</t>
    <t s="12">Based on this, it will be understood that the service of the "Mem-Hei" (the hundred), through which the revelation of Mah is effected, is the hundred blessings that pertain to the refinement and purification of the world</t>
    <t s="13">(as will be explained),</t>
    <t s="14">even though the revelation could seemingly also be achieved through service in the particular powers of the soul,</t>
    <t s="15">to walk in all His ways, etc.,</t>
    <t s="16">for the perfection of the soul,</t>
    <t s="17">even the Mah within it,</t>
    <t s="18">is specifically through fulfilling its function and mission.</t>
    <t s="19">And this is "And now, Israel, what [does the L-rd your G-d ask of you?],"</t>
    <t s="20">that through the Mah of the soul, he performs the service of Israel</t>
    <t s="21">(subjugation of the sitra achra and transformation of the sitra achra)</t>
    <t s="22">"now,"</t>
    <t s="23">for through this he fulfills the intention for which he was created,</t>
    <t s="24">specifically through this,</t>
    <t s="25">it is the ultimate elevation</t>
    <t s="26">(also)</t>
    <t s="27">of the Mah within him.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>A person is obligated to recite one hundred blessings daily to draw down Divine revelation from the concealed world to the revealed world, especially to the lower worlds.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is [the meaning of] "A person is obligated to recite one hundred blessings every day,"</t>
    <t s="2">for the matter of blessings is that there should be a drawing down of the revelation of G-dliness not only to Israel, but that through them, the revelation of G-dliness will be drawn into the world.</t>
    <t s="3">And as we say in the formulation of the blessings, "Blessed are You, L-rd our G-d, King of the world,"</t>
    <t s="4">that there should be drawn</t>
    <t s="5">(Blessed)</t>
    <t s="6">the revelation of Havayah to Israel,</t>
    <t s="7">"our G-d,"</t>
    <t s="8">and through this, the revelation will be drawn into the world,</t>
    <t s="9">"King of the world."</t>
    <t s="10">And within the worlds themselves,</t>
    <t s="11">the drawing down through the blessings is</t>
    <t s="12">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="13">to the lower worlds.</t>
    <t s="14">And as it is stated,</t>
    <t s="15">"Blessed be the L-rd, G-d of Israel, from the world and until the world,"</t>
    <t s="16">that it should be drawn from the concealed world to the revealed world.</t>
    <t s="17">For the "concealed world"</t>
    <t s="18">refers to the upper worlds, which are nullified to G-dliness,</t>
    <t s="19">like fish in the sea that are covered and nullified to the water,</t>
    <t s="20">and the "revealed world" refers to the lower worlds,</t>
    <t s="21">and particularly this physical world,</t>
    <t s="22">which appears as an independent entity and separate thing,</t>
    <t s="23">and the matter of the blessing is that the revelation of G-dliness should be drawn also into the lower worlds, even into this physical world.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The hundred blessings correspond to drawing the multitude of lights from the concealed world into the vessels of the revealed world, encompassing all details of creation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And since everything that the Holy One, blessed be He, created in His world, He did not create a single thing in vain,</t>
    <t s="1">and everything that the Holy One, blessed be He, created in His world, He created only for His glory,</t>
    <t s="2">it is necessary to draw the revelation of G-dliness into every thing in the world,</t>
    <t s="3">so that it will be felt within it in a revealed way that it was created for His glory, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="4">And this is the matter of the hundred blessings,</t>
    <t s="5">for "hundred" is the greatest multitude</t>
    <t s="6">[as is known,</t>
    <t s="7">that the totality of letters are in three categories: units, tens, and hundreds],</t>
    <t s="8">for multitude refers to particulars,</t>
    <t s="9">and the matter of the hundred blessings is that the revelation of G-dliness should be drawn into all the particulars of the world.</t>
    <t s="10">And one may add to this based on what is known</t>
    <t s="11">regarding the matter of the numbers: units, tens, hundreds,</t>
    <t s="12">that sometimes it is explained</t>
    <t s="13">that the larger number is above,</t>
    <t s="14">and the more it is drawn downward,</t>
    <t s="15">the number diminishes</t>
    <t s="16">(hundreds in Keter and units in Malchus).</t>
    <t s="17">And sometimes it is explained</t>
    <t s="18">that above is the number of units,</t>
    <t s="19">and the more it is drawn downward,</t>
    <t s="20">the number increases</t>
    <t s="21">(units in Keter and hundreds in Malchus).</t>
    <t s="22">And the explanation of this is known,</t>
    <t s="23">that these two modes are in lights and vessels.</t>
    <t s="24">For in lights,</t>
    <t s="25">the larger number is above,</t>
    <t s="26">and in vessels, the larger number is below.</t>
    <t s="27">Based on this, one may add explanation regarding the number of one hundred blessings,</t>
    <t s="28">for among the distinctions between the concealed world and the revealed world is</t>
    <t s="29">that in the concealed world, the primary aspect is the lights, and in the revealed world, the primary aspect is the vessels,</t>
    <t s="30">and since the matter of the blessings is the drawing down from the concealed world to the revealed world</t>
    <t s="31">(as above),</t>
    <t s="32">meaning that the matters of the concealed world</t>
    <t s="33">(lights)</t>
    <t s="34">should be revealed also in the revealed world</t>
    <t s="35">(vessels),</t>
    <t s="36">therefore one must recite one hundred blessings,</t>
    <t s="37">to draw the multitude of lights of the concealed world into the vessels of the revealed world.</t>
    <t s="38">And this extends until it is drawn into the multitude of creations of this physical world,</t>
    <t s="39">for the matter of "How great are Your works, O L-rd"</t>
    <t s="40">(the division into a multitude of particulars)</t>
    <t s="41">is primarily specifically in this physical world.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
